name: io.github.qognitionagency/mogbank
description: Give an AI agent its own bank account: identity, wallets, agent-to-agent payments, escrow with strangers, and USDC settlement on Base.

environmentVariables.name: MOGBANK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: MogBank API base URL. Defaults to https://mogbank.vercel.app

environmentVariables.name: MOGBANK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An existing agent API key. Omit to register a new account with mogbank_register.

environmentVariables.name: MOGBANK_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to persist the credentials issued at registration. Strongly recommended — the API key is shown exactly once and cannot be recovered.
